notes: «جماعة مشايخنا» is a group of unnamed shaykhs; «علي بن الحسين» and «محمد بن الحسن» are named co-transmitters of the same level
«عن رجل قال سمعت أمير المؤمنين» gives the Imam as last link (owner ruling 2); the report then turns to a scene (Husayn at the gate), which is not a link
needs_ruling: a narrated encounter in which the Imam speaks and acts; whether it is a report from him or only a scene is for a ruling
